name: Adobe Express
tagline: Quick design app for social graphics, flyers, short videos and more.
shortDescription: Design app from Adobe for creating social posts, flyers, simple videos and other content from templates, with AI features.
description: Adobe Express is a design app for making social media graphics, flyers, presentations, short videos and other content, usually starting from a template.
It is aimed at people who need good-looking content quickly without learning professional design software. Adobe has added generative AI features; check which are included in each plan.
There is a free plan and a paid plan with more templates, assets and features.

pricing.notes: Demo profile: plan names and prices have not been recorded yet. Check the official website for current pricing.

keyFeatures.title: Templates
keyFeatures.description: Start from templates for social posts, stories, flyers, thumbnails and more.

keyFeatures.title: Quick actions
keyFeatures.description: One-click tasks such as removing an image background or resizing for another platform.

keyFeatures.title: Generative AI features
keyFeatures.description: Create or edit images and text effects with AI. Usage limits may apply per plan.

keyFeatures.title: Simple video
keyFeatures.description: Create short videos and animations for social media.

howItWorks: Sign in with an Adobe account on the web or mobile app.
Search templates for the format you need.
Replace text, images and colours with your own.
Download or share directly to your channels.
useCases: Event flyers and simple marketing materials
bestFor: Small businesses and creators without a designer
cons: Some templates, assets and AI features require the paid plan
Less control than professional design tools

checklist: Time to produce a social post and story from a template
Free vs premium template ratio for common formats
Generative AI usage limits on the free plan on the date of testing

faqs.a: Adobe Express has a free plan and a paid plan. Check the official pricing page for what each includes.

faqs.q: Is Adobe Express a Canva alternative?
faqs.a: They serve similar template-based design needs. Compare template libraries, AI features and pricing for your use case.
